messages.subject: Caspian — IP licence bring-down
messages.plaintextBody:
James — separate to Indigo: can you pick up the bring-down on the Caspian Technologies IP licence (Project Indigo's namesake over there is unrelated) before Thursday? The client wants the royalty model refreshed. Nothing to do with the photonics deal — just flagging so it doesn't slip while we're heads-down on the Series B.

--
Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Corporate & Financing
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 1100
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
